sources.title: omurberaisik/NoTokenLM-Gen-3.5-Focused · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Focused is a continuation training run on top of the Gen-3.5 checkpoint, using a narrower, simpler-narrative dataset (TinyStories-only, after an earlier c4/math/synth mix was found to inject a "word-problem" register into unrelated prompts) chosen specifically to reinforce subject tracking and short-story structure, rather than adding new capability or new knowledge.

sources.title: omurberaisik/NoTokenLM-Gen-3.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Head-to-head: this model vs. its predecessor (NoTokenLM-Gen-2.5) We compared this model against its direct predecessor (Gen-2.5, ~3.1M parameters, GPT-2-style architecture: GELU, LayerNorm, learned position embeddings) on 8 held-out English sentences the models weren't trained on, by loading both models' raw weights directly and checking which one predicts each sentence better.
